A340E (2JZ—GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION – TROUBLESHOOTING

Stop Light Switch Circuit

— CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION —

The purpose of this circuit is to prevent the engine from stalling, while driving in lock–up condition, when brakes are suddenly applied.
When the brake pedal is operated, this switch sends a signal to the ECM. Then the ECM cancels operation of the lock–up clutch while braking is in progress.
